RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is not evidence that sex influenced the outcome, but it is a legitimate procedural concern in its own right — many public broadcasters have balanced-panel policies, and breaching one is a fair thing to question. On its own it proves nothing: "strong digital experience" is a genuinely common priority in newsrooms, and eight years can beat fifteen if the brief was transformation.

Your stronger point is the ignored request. Chase the written explanation in writing, citing any internal policy and deadline. Ask what criteria were scored and how. Mention panel composition factually, as one question among several — not as your headline. If the reasons turn out vague or shifting, then escalate.
